entities.summary: Colton James Brennan was an American football quarterback. He played college football for the Colorado Buffaloes, Saddleback Gauchos, and Hawaii Rainbow Warriors. With the Rainbow Warriors, he was a two-time third-team All-American and two-time NCAA passing leader. Brennan was selected by the Washington Redskins of the National Football League (NFL) in the sixth round of the 2008 NFL draft, but never played in a regular season NFL game.
